name: Bench smoke - nothing but the control cable
_note: Every step here is judgeable with only the USB-RS232 adapter on C05/C06/C02. No fixture board, no loopback wire, no card. It exists to prove the plan file, the executor and the report work on a real board before any of the wired checks are attempted. Limits are engineering starting points, NOT production limits: see $PROD/maps/production-test-gap/.

steps._note: The board answers with its UID and the tool version. Proves the control link before anything is judged on it.
The FMC is not up in this image until the test brings it up itself. ready=0 here means MX_FMC_Init() ran and the controller still did not come ready.

Two LM50s on the Lower Deck, plus the reference gate they sit behind. ok=1 says VREFBUF came up (without it the analog ports refuse to start at all); vdda is derived from VREFINT, not measured at a terminal. ch<n> is mV/deci-Celsius, so [1] is the temperature - the band is a room-temperature sanity check, not a specification.

checks._note: vdda= is the ADC reference, not VDDA: VREFBUF drives VREF+ to a nominal 2.5 V and a healthy board reads about 2501 mV (measured 2026-09-08). The 2000-3600 band this replaces would have passed a board whose VREFBUF had failed and left VREF+ sitting near 3.3 V.

steps._note: The RTC is not up in this image until the target brings it up. init=0 just means nobody ever set the calendar, which is normal on a fresh board - it is not judged here. clk=lse since 2026-09-10 - the calendar counts the crystal, not the internal RC. The field is read out of RCC_BDCR, so it cannot disagree with the hardware.

⚠️ This proves the firmware drove PE2, NOT that the lamp lit - there is no readback on that pin, and the reply says observed=unknown. Watch the board while this step runs: six pulses, half a second each. A verdict on what was seen needs a UserConfirm step, which is not built yet.
loop=self: the link under test IS the control port, so this round trip really does prove that link. rxlines climbs because the executor's own commands arrive on it.
Runs whatever happened above, so a failed step cannot leave a relay energised or an analog output driving.
